changelog:
v5.2.2 — 4K fixes and faster search

• 4K shows and movies no longer close the app a few seconds in on boxes with less memory, like the Ooustick.

• On devices that can't play 4K, a 4K title now tells you right away and suggests an HD version, instead of trying to play it slowly until the app closes.

• Search is faster and no longer freezes the app on smaller devices.

• Voice search from your Fire TV or Android TV remote now opens your results in OOUStream.
